lines.text: Um... there are people... at a café. And, uh... a lamp. It's... nice?
lines.style: Speak English as a Japanese beginner who learned it from textbooks: katakana-like vowels added after consonants, r and l mixed up, flat syllable-by-syllable timing, every syllable equally stressed. Unsure but keep going at a steady, fairly quick pace: only short pauses (about a quarter second) at the dots, no long silences; the whole line takes about four seconds. Keep it natural, not a caricature.
